goal: Repeat the reference strategy: grasp opposite rack rims, lift one rack clear of the stack, invert approximately 180 degrees, place onto the washer entry conveyor, release, and repeat.

robot.hands: Tesollo DG5F-S manufacturer left + right, 20 DOF each

physics.belt_transport: Not modeled; reconstructed wire surface is stationary. No artificial belt-force term.

uncertainties: Monocular video does not identify absolute dimensions, mass, friction, compliance or actuator dynamics.
Rack outer dimensions and nominal mass borrow VAB; shell/rib/clip geometry was reconstructed from selected video frames.
Rim cross-section and unseen underside remain approximate.
Camera fit uses manually selected four rack corners and assumed dimensions; moving-camera trajectory is not yet fitted.
Washer source mesh is an approximate benchmark model, with reconstructed window, grid and control details.
Contact stability is numerical evidence, not experimental physical calibration.

asset_sources.machine: Local Variational-Automation-Benchmark crate_washing mesh, MIT source license copied.
asset_sources.rack: Procedural reference-derived replacement; VAB v5 rejected after rendered inspection.
asset_sources.UR5e: Existing local MuJoCo Menagerie UR5e asset; license copied.
asset_sources.hands: Local Tesollo BSD-3-Clause manufacturer CAD and inertial properties.

rendering: Blender Cycles + OptiX through a RoboSimStudio renderer plugin. Exact live Newton visual geometry and body transforms; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1. OVRTX GPU-mask interop failed, so it is not used.
